name: rotless
description: Build agent skills that stay accurate and improve with use: prior art, building and testing, drift checks, and lessons from real use.

interface.longDescription: Four skills for authoring agent skills: research prior art before building, build and test skills, check what each skill relies on for drift, and turn lessons from real use into small edits that each come with a check. Runs Python scripts and the GitHub CLI on your machine; nothing runs in the background.
